info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Product Quality Assurance Reviews API
info.description: The Product Quality Assurance Reviews API facilitates the submission of reviews for banking products, enhancing quality assurance processes. This endpoint allows businesses to gather customer feedback on product performance and quality, which is essential for ongoing product improvement. Typical consumers include product managers, quality assurance teams, and customer service representatives who rely on customer insights. By enabling detailed review submissions, this API supports data-driven enhancements in product offerings.

post.summary: Submit a new review for the specified product quality assurance.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create and submit a new review for the product quality assurance process associated with the product identified by PROD-700045. Make sure to include all necessary information in the request body for effective processing.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit a review for the product identified by PROD-700045. The review contains user feedback, ratings, and other relevant details that contribute to the product's quality assurance process.
